tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Values and primary titles on viewer, app, panel and raised (15.7:1+ dark, 14.2:1+ light, 10.2:1+ gray).

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Control labels and ordinary copy on app, panel and raised (7.3:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary information, inactive tabs, default slider values, section labels on app, panel and raised (5.8:1+ dark; 4.4:1 on light app and 4.5:1 on gray raised, both borderline).

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: Nonessential metadata, idle workflow step numbers, drag grips. FAILS 4.5:1 for text in every theme (about 3:1 to 3.7:1); never use for copy a person must read.

tokens.name: error-text
tokens.usage: Error message copy inside status rows on panel.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bright fills: primary (ultraviolet) buttons and the amber Export run button.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Burnt orange, the default accent: focus ring, modified slider fill, selected tab underline, visible bypass eye, primary and Export buttons, ON switch marking. Keep it spatially small. 4.8:1 on dark panel; on Studio Gray it is 4.1:1, so small text there uses accent-strong. People can change it in Settings (see accent-preset-*).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Lighter accent for text and icons that must read: selected segment and tool ink, Mod tags, the FINE tag, rendition section labels (6.9:1 dark; darker #8a3a14 on light, 6.9:1; 5.7:1 gray).

tokens.name: accent-low
tokens.usage: Lower edge of accent gradients (fills, primary button).

tokens.name: accent-bed
tokens.usage: Tinted seat beneath a selected Library row or tile and behind Mod tags.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Ink on a solid accent fill: primary and Export button labels (5.1:1 dark, 5.8:1 light in white, 6.4:1 gray).

tokens.name: accent-preset-burnt-orange
tokens.usage: Settings swatch: the default accent.

tokens.name: accent-preset-blue-gray
tokens.usage: Settings swatch: the understated accent. Only 3.2:1 on the dark panel, so text in this mode uses a 28% lighter mix (#8d9ab3, 6.6:1); its on-accent ink is white.

tokens.name: accent-preset-coating-blue
tokens.usage: Settings swatch: a cooler accent, kept apart from the scope blue channel by its cyan lean.

tokens.name: ready
tokens.usage: Successful readiness. Pair with a word or icon. Constant across themes: only 1.9:1 on the light panel, so on light use it as a mark, not text.

tokens.name: headroom
tokens.usage: HDR headroom as data (scopes, peak readouts). No longer a UI warning or the Export button colour, so it never sits next to the orange accent as chrome.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Warnings that need review: status-bar warning text and rules, Rematch SDR. Yellow, so it reads apart from the burnt-orange accent (11.4:1 on dark panel; Default Light uses a darker #735600, 5.9:1).

tokens.name: blocking
tokens.usage: Errors and blocking state: status-row left rule. Pair with error-text copy.

tokens.name: clip
tokens.usage: Alias of blocking for clipping indicators.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success status-row rule. Used in code only as a fallback value (var(--success, #62b78f)); not declared in :root.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Library star ratings: neutral, so they never compete with the orange accent or the yellow warning. Marks sit beneath a photo, never on it.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel and region titles (CONTROL PANEL, METADATA, PREVIEW). Uppercase, ink text.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section kickers inside panels (BOTH RENDITIONS, PER RENDITION, NEW ADJUSTMENT, field labels). Uppercase, ink quiet or muted.

styles.name: spec-label
styles.usage: Labels in the spec plate (BODY, FOCAL, EXP, ISO) and the key legend. Uppercase, ink muted.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Small boxed state tags (FINE, SNAP) and the ON/OFF marking in a switch. Uppercase.

styles.name: scale-label
styles.usage: Snap-point labels under a slider rail. Tabular numbers, ink muted.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base UI text, menus, explanations, helper and empty-state copy.
styles.sample: Choose a mask tool to start an adjustment.

styles.name: group-name
styles.usage: Control-group names in sentence case (Tone, Exposure bands). Ink text.

styles.name: workflow-tab
styles.usage: Top workflow tabs (Library, Grade, Proof, Export).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary and Export button labels; secondary buttons use weight 500.

styles.name: control-label
styles.usage: Instrument slider names, left of the value. Ink body.

styles.name: segment
styles.usage: HDR grade / SDR grade and other segment items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status bar, secondary rows, Settings notes, Revert / Copy path.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Slider values, units and numeric readouts, always with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). Ink muted at default, text when modified.

styles.name: spec-value
styles.usage: Spec plate values (NIKON D200, 55 mm, f/8 · 1/320 s). Tabular, ink body.

styles.name: step-index
styles.usage: Workflow step numbers (01 to 04). Tabular; accent when active, quiet otherwise.

styles.name: filename
styles.usage: Library tile file names and paths only. Ink muted.
